summary: Connect strategy, KPIs and review routines with practical performance tools. Explore the 5-day organizational performance training course.
lede: Organizational performance training helps leaders and performance professionals connect strategic priorities to measurable outcomes and review decisions. Participants practise mapping strategy to measures, defining KPI ownership and checking performance data. They also use recurring review routines to examine variances and agree corrective actions, with foundation-level introductions to EFQM self-assessment, benchmarking and logic models for framing performance questions across functions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for translating organizational priorities into measures, review decisions and follow-through across functions. It is designed for people who need a practical foundation in performance management, including work in matrixed teams.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is specified. Familiarity with organizational objectives, budgets or service measures can help you connect the exercises to your work. No coding is required.
